scope: Fictional, experimental inputs only; not a game specification or a real-world setting.
interpretation: The plaque is a small local addition indicating a change of affiliation between invented moments; no historical or geographical claims are implied. The baseline affiliation is an experimental annotation, not encoded in the P1 model.
uvRepair: First P2 assets and old UV baseline are in uv-repair-before. To rebuild the augmented UV baseline, run python3 -I route-a/extend-uv.py ../route-a/city.glb uv-repair-before/city.glb. This checks position, normal and index bytes before adding the three P1 sidewalk UVs. Then run Blender as in the parent README; output stays in p2/route-a.
invalidCapture: inspection/snapshots/p2-repaired-2026-11-20T05-47-34-399Z was captured on an already occupied port, not the intended server; retained but not used as evidence.

targetCloseup.method: inspection/capture-target.mjs translates both cameras toward (-13, 1.5, -14), orthographic height 10, keeping original shared view direction. Serve P1 and P2 separately, then capture each URL. Both normal and close files use this same target camera.

assetIntegrity: route-a/manifest.json binds the GLB SHA-256 and input snapshot; generation updates the manifest after UV restoration. Browser rejects mismatched input or bytes. The manifest is not an authenticity guarantee.
buildOutput: build/node_modules/.cache/ is a local output directory, not the linked external node_modules.
